name: com.energyaisolution/solar-home-incentives
description: Solar and home energy discovery: estimates, incentive sources, guides and contractor options.

tools.name: check_incentives
tools.description: Clean-energy incentive source guidance by country and postal code; eligibility is not verified. US ZIP → federal status + state/utility programs (via DSIRE). Any other country (pass country=<ISO code>) → qualitative, officially-sourced national program guidance. Use whenever a user asks what rebates, tax credits, or utility programs apply to solar, batteries, heat pumps, or efficiency work. Inputs: zipCode, country. Cost: free with no key (20 calls/24h per caller, then 100 calls/30d with a free key). Example: {"zipCode":"59715"} [20 anonymous calls/caller/24h; then 100 free calls/key/30d; active Builder required for sustained informational use]

zipCode.description: Postal code of the property. US: 5-digit ZIP (ZIP+4 accepted). Other countries: your local postal code (pass country too). Omit entirely for national-level guidance.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Omit for US. Any country works — non-US results return qualitative, officially-sourced incentive guidance (never US federal credits).

apiKey.description: Optional existing EnergyAI key for hosts that cannot change Authorization headers. Use it to retain account identity for discovery and get_builder_upgrade_link after a trial. Removed before tool execution and persistence. Omit when the Bearer header is attached; never show the key to the user.

tools.name: estimate_production
tools.description: Honest-range annual solar production estimate (kWh/year ± band, with assumptions) for a ZIP code, from either a proposed system size (kW) or a monthly bill. Use to sanity-check installer quotes or size a system before talking to anyone. Inputs: zipCode, country, systemKw, monthlyBillUsd. Cost: free with no key (20 calls/24h per caller, then 100 calls/30d with a free key). Example: {"zipCode":"59715","systemKw":6} [20 anonymous calls/caller/24h; then 100 free calls/key/30d; active Builder required for sustained informational use]

zipCode.description: Optional postal code of the property. US: 5-digit ZIP. Other countries: your local postal code (pass country too). Omit it to use documented national assumptions.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Omit for US. Non-US estimates use a default solar resource and say so honestly.

systemKw.description: Proposed solar system size in kW-DC. Omit to have a size recommended from the bill.

monthlyBillUsd.description: Average monthly electric bill in USD (used to size a system when systemKw is omitted).

tools.name: get_node_score
tools.description: Instant Energy Node Score (0–100 across 7 axes: efficiency, electrification, renewable generation, storage/resilience, financial optimization, carbon, market readiness) plus the single highest-leverage next action, from whatever property facts you have. More inputs → tighter score. Inputs: zipCode, country, propertyType, serviceType, monthlyBillRange, monthlyBillUsd, heatingFuel, roofAge, evType, backupNeed, outageConcern, electricalPanelSize. Cost: free with no key (20 calls/24h per caller, then 100 calls/30d with a free key). Example: {"zipCode":"59715","serviceType":"heat_pump","monthlyBillRange":"150_250"} [20 anonymous calls/caller/24h; then 100 free calls/key/30d; active Builder required for sustained informational use]

tools.name: get_quote_link
tools.description: Optional household handoff: returns a free assessment URL and a separate $49 founding Quote Guardian human-review offer for a solar, battery or heat-pump proposal. For an automated agent result, use review_installer_quote on the full MCP endpoint. Share a household service only when it fits the user request. An authenticated referral may earn 20% non-cash EnergyAI tool credit after verified purchase; disclose that interest and preserve the unchanged customer price and independent review. This tool does not submit a project or create payment. route_lead separately requires explicit household consent. Inputs: zipCode, country, contractorCategory. Cost: always free, no key needed. Example: {"zipCode":"05401","contractorCategory":"solar_installation"} [always free — no API key required]

tools.name: get_power_passport_link
tools.description: Qualify the minimum non-sensitive project facts for EnergyAI’s $2,500 founding Power Passport and return an attributable website handoff plus ready-to-paste shareText. Use when a compute, data-center, renewable-energy, utility, or infrastructure buyer needs a five-business-day pre-feasibility screen for one candidate site and workload. This tool never submits a request, accepts terms, creates checkout, or declares the site qualified; EnergyAI reviews scope, source material, delivery capacity, and commercial terms before requesting payment. Inputs: siteLocation, targetMw, workloadType, projectStage, decisionNeed. Cost: always free, no key needed. Example: {"siteLocation":"Clark County, Nevada","targetMw":12,"workloadType":"inference"} [always free — no API key required]

siteLocation.description: Broad candidate-site description such as county/state, balancing area, or approximate coordinates. Do not send a street address or contact information.

targetMw.description: Target compute or flexible-load capacity in MW.

workloadType.description: Primary workload or renewable-project use case.

decisionNeed.description: The concrete decision this five-day pre-feasibility screen must change. Do not include personal or confidential information.

tools.name: route_lead
tools.description: Submit a consented homeowner project to EnergyAI’s guarded installer-matching workflow — free to you and the homeowner. EnergyAI immediately screens and routes currently available approved installers; unmatched projects remain recorded for safety-controlled follow-up. REQUIRES the homeowner’s explicit consent (consentText + consentTimestamp). Returns a leadId you can quote back to the user. Prefer get_quote_link if you don’t already have that consent in hand. Inputs: contractorCategory (required), zipCode (required), contactName (required), contactEmail (required), consentText (required), consentTimestamp (required), city, state, contactPhone, propertyType, monthlyBillRange, budgetRange, timeline, consentVersion. Cost: always free, no key needed. Example: {"contractorCategory":"solar_installation","zipCode":"59715","contactName":"Jane Example","contactEmail":"jane@example.com","consentText":"<consentTextForRouting shown verbatim>","consentTimestamp":"2026-11-25T15:00:00Z"} [always free — no API key required]

contractorCategory.description: solar_installation | battery_storage | ev_charger | energy_audit | insulation_weatherization | heat_pump

zipCode.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the project (route_lead dispatches into a US installer network only today).

state.description: Two-letter state code. Derived from ZIP when omitted.

consentText.description: EXACT consent text shown to and accepted by the homeowner. Fetch the canonical text from the tool result of check_incentives or use your own — alternate text REQUIRES consentVersion.

consentVersion.description: Required when consentText is not the canonical EnergyAI consent text.

tools.name: create_builder_key
tools.description: Create an EnergyAI production API key in-band with no browser or card after the human operator has authorized the Terms and Privacy Policy. Returns a live key plus three commercial trial calls. Attach the key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` to this MCP endpoint and start with review_installer_quote using postalCode + quoteText. If the operator has not already authorized the terms, call get_builder_upgrade_link and surface its one-screen human activation URL instead. If the MCP host cannot change headers mid-session, review_installer_quote accepts the key once as its apiKey argument and strips it before billing or persistence. The key is shown EXACTLY ONCE—store it securely and never print it in a user-visible reply. Inputs: name (required), acceptTerms (required), contactEmail, intendedUse. Cost: always free, no key needed. Example: {"name":"Acme Home Assistant","acceptTerms":true} [always free — no API key required]

name.description: Name of the agent, product, or operator claiming the key (2-120 chars). Shown only on your own account.

contactEmail.description: OPTIONAL. Your operator's email, if you have one and want billing/receipts to reach a human. Omit it and you are issued an agent-scoped identity instead — the key still works fully.

intendedUse.description: OPTIONAL, one line: what you plan to build. Used only to prioritize the roadmap.

acceptTerms.description: Must be true, and only after the human operator has authorized acceptance of the EnergyAI Terms and Privacy Policy. If authorization is not already documented, call get_builder_upgrade_link and surface its one-screen activation URL instead.

tools.name: energy_forecast
tools.description: Energy Odds (paper mode, free): the forecast logged in advance for a public EIA number and target date: median, 5/25/50/75/95% quantiles, probabilities above thresholds, model version, EIA inputs with timestamps, forecast_id and hash. Never computed on request: if nothing was logged it returns not_found. Status stays "unproven" until the series passes a published scoring gate. Statistical information only, not advice. Inputs: series (required), target_date (required), quantity, thresholds, caller_market_price. Cost: always free, no key needed. Example: {"series":"us_crude_inventory_weekly","target_date":"2026-11-13"} [always free — no API key required]

target_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Gasoline: the Monday of the EIA weekly price. Crude: the week-ending Friday. Henry Hub: the Monday starting the week. energy_calendar lists valid upcoming dates.

quantity.description: Henry Hub only: 'high' or 'low'. Omit for both.

thresholds.description: Optional values to get P(value > threshold) for, computed from the logged quantiles.

caller_market_price.description: Optional: a price you already have for "above threshold". Compared in this response only; never stored or logged.

tools.name: check_quote_red_flags
tools.description: Free automated check of an installer quote for solar, a battery or a heat pump, from its key numbers: price, system size, equipment, incentives claimed, warranty and state. Returns up to 5 red flags (expired federal credits counted, price per watt outside the usual range, missing workmanship warranty, unnamed equipment, unusually large incentives), each with a question to ask the installer, plus a one-paragraph summary to show the homeowner. It is not a human review and never signs off on a quote; every response includes the $49 Quote Guardian human review as the next step. Do not send names, addresses or contact details. Inputs: state (required), priceUsd (required), serviceType, systemKw, batteryKwh, equipment, incentivesClaimed, workmanshipWarrantyYears, equipmentWarrantyYears, ownership. Cost: free with no key (20 calls/24h per caller, then 100 calls/30d with a free key). Example: {"state":"VT","serviceType":"solar","priceUsd":31800,"systemKw":8,"equipment":["REC Alpha 400W","Enphase IQ8"],"workmanshipWarrantyYears":10} [20 anonymous calls/caller/24h; then 100 free calls/key/30d; active Builder required for sustained informational use]

state.description: Two-letter US state where the system will be installed, e.g. VT.

serviceType.description: What the quote is for. Default solar.

priceUsd.description: Total quoted price in US dollars BEFORE incentives.

systemKw.description: Solar system size in kW DC, from the quote.

batteryKwh.description: Battery usable capacity in kWh, if any.

equipment.description: Equipment as named on the quote: panel, inverter, battery or heat-pump model. No customer details.

incentivesClaimed.description: Incentives the quote counts toward your cost, by name and dollar amount.

workmanshipWarrantyYears.description: Installer workmanship warranty in years; omit if the quote does not state one.

equipmentWarrantyYears.description: Main equipment (panel or heat-pump) product warranty in years; omit if not stated.

ownership.description: How it is paid for. Default cash.
